title: malus prunifolia f. lutea
intro: Malus prunifolia f. lutea, commonly known as Chinese golden pear, is a plant species within the Rosaceae family that is traditionally used in Chinese medicine. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including the potential to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Malus prunifolia f. lutea are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and lipid-lowering properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoid saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
